fixture.serialization: 16-byte little-endian header, 10000 8-byte entity records, 1000 one-byte control records

systems.work: update every entity; apply the frame control to entity indexes congruent to frame modulo 257; reflect at 0 and 65535
rebuild a 128 by 128 linked-list grid; test same-cell and east, southwest, south, southeast cells; swap both velocity components for inclusive radius overlap
update every entity from current velocity class and the frame control

layout.entity: structure of arrays: uint16 x/y, int8 vx/vy, uint8 animation/radius
layout.grid: 16384 signed head indexes plus one signed next index per entity

oracle.digest: FNV-1a-style uint32 multiply/xor over canonical fields; structural equality also checks all 60000 state words

variants.semantics: all three systems and the complete state oracle execute in authored JavaScript
all three systems and the complete state oracle execute in authored C compiled to fixed-memory linear Wasm; JavaScript only copies input and decodes output

rendering: not part of compute; the demo renders textual correctness output after the worker completes
